_comment: Screenshot manifest for `node ~/alvaro/scripts/nexo-shots.mjs .`. Underscore-prefixed keys are comments (JSON has none) — the script ignores them.
_rules: LOCAL instance only, seeded with DemoSeeder (design.md, Family): `docker compose up -d` then `artisan migrate:fresh --seed --seeder=DemoSeeder`. Never production — these figures are the landing's proof, and the proof cannot be somebody's real account.
_sessions: The third figure needs its own capture pass, one file at a time. Every shot with "auth": true signs in for real and every sign-in writes a row into the session store, so a single run leaves the second, third and fourth session captures showing the rig's own logins — same IP, seconds apart — instead of the demo's three devices. Ordering the shots first only protects the first file. To regenerate figure 3 honestly: for each of the four outputs, re-seed (`artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeeder`, which clears the demo user's sessions) and then capture that one output on its own. Every other figure here regenerates fine in a normal full run.
_pkce: The consent URL carries a fixed PKCE pair so the manifest stays reproducible: verifier `nexo-demo-pkce-verifier-2026-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv`, challenge = base64url(sha256(verifier)), method S256 (EnforcePkceS256 rejects `plain`). Nothing is exchanged — the capture stops at the consent screen.
_migrate: `migrate:fresh` wipes the local nexo_id schema, OAuth clients included. If another tool's local SSO test relied on a client you registered by hand, re-register it: this seeder only creates its own.
